instagram.caption:
What the drawer is for.
The Entry Console or Bench in the Entryway. Somewhere to sit while you lace a boot, and somewhere to set a bag down for thirty seconds.

What done looks like:
1. Three items or fewer on the top
2. A seat with nothing on it at all
3. A drawer where every divided section has one named category
4. You can see the base of the drawer between things

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success entry console or bench.
